##### Project general facts

Les Vagues by Elie Saab is Qatar's first branded residences, developed by DarGlobal. The offering comprises three waterfront buildings, Les Vagues A, B and D, presenting one, two and three-bedroom apartments with panoramic sea views, designed to capture uninterrupted sea views and create a refined island lifestyle. The development is positioned as an opulent seafront address, blending contemporary architectural lines with a couture design pedigree.

Residents have access to a curated set of amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness centre, an infinity swimming pool, and a landscaped community courtyard with sea views. The development also offers à la carte concierge services, four passenger elevators including a dedicated service elevator to all floors, luxury retail, a 24-hour reception desk, and parking for all units. Public areas are furnished and designed by Elie Saab.

Interiors are curated by Elie Saab in a palette of creams and greys, with shiny metal finishes, bronze, marble and noble stone detailing throughout. Floor-to-ceiling windows maximize natural light and open up panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Doha skyline, while features such as winter gardens enhance the connection between indoor and outdoor living. Spaces are designed using a refined palette of neutral tones, complemented by marble, metals, and high-end finishes that create a timeless and luxurious atmosphere. Every detail is carefully considered, from layout to materials, ensuring both comfort and privacy while maintaining a strong design identity. The result is a collection of residences that combine haute couture aesthetics with everyday functionality, offering a truly elevated living experience by the sea.Les Vagues A residences include a Winter Garden that blends indoor and outdoor living. The residences are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits 


Qetaifan Island North is a landmark waterfront destination located in Lusail, just north of Doha, designed as one of Qatar’s most vibrant leisure and residential hubs. Developed as part of the country’s long-term vision, the island combines resort-style living with entertainment and tourism, creating a unique coastal community. Its strategic location near Lusail City places residents within easy reach of Doha’s key districts while offering a more relaxed, island lifestyle.

The island is defined by its contemporary master plan, featuring a mix of residential towers, branded hotels, beach clubs, and retail promenades. One of its standout attractions is Meryal Waterpark, one of the largest waterparks in the region, alongside landscaped public spaces, marinas, and direct beach access. The architecture reflects a modern seaside aesthetic, with clean lines, open views of the Arabian Gulf, and a strong focus on outdoor living and waterfront experiences.

Qetaifan Island North offers a lifestyle centered around leisure, comfort, and entertainment. Residents and visitors enjoy access to beaches, dining venues, retail outlets, and family-friendly attractions, all within a walkable and well-planned environment. With its blend of tourism appeal and residential opportunities, the island is positioned as one of the most distinctive destinations in Qatar, ideal for both living and investment.
